question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Man's learning can (i) is an act of not be complete disapprovation of good manners (b) Childhood is the (ii) insulting our elders proper time (c) Denying the order of (iii) without acquisition of parents good manner (d) What is expected as (iv) of decency in dealing good manners in a with others country (e) We should have the (v) for learning good sense manners (vi) may not be. the same in another country
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (iii) Man's learning cannot be complete without acquisition of good manner. (b) + (v) Childhood is the proper time for learning good manners. (c) + (i) Denying the order of parents is an act of disapprovation of good manners. (d) + (vi) What is expected as good manners in a country may not be the same in another country. (e) + (iv) We should have the sense of decency in dealing with others.
